svg.title: The production engine and the simulation engine
svg.desc: Left, the production engine behind lockstep.New: a global queue of ready actors and a pool of workers, each with a local queue. A worker takes a ready actor from its local queue, then from the global queue, and steals half of another worker's local queue when both are empty. Turns of different actors run in parallel; one actor's turns never overlap. Right, the simulation engine behind sim.Simulate: one kernel runs one event at a time in virtual-time order, and the seed decides the order. Below, the two compared: turns run in parallel or one at a time; the turn budget is 32 messages by default or 1; time is the wall clock or virtual time; randomness is seeded from crypto/rand or derived from the seed; effects call Run on a bounded pool or call a test handler; a rerun has new timings, while a seed replays exactly.
